newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products held steady by futures' stability.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products held steady by futures' stability.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Thursday, helped by more confident futures, Thursday, traders said.
Spot and paper naphtha prices remained easy, but firmer afternoon crude provided some support.
Gasoline markets went into holding mode after falling sharply on Wednesday, looking to the U.S. for direction after Tuesday's raft of bearish APIs.
Gas oil held broadly on futures that were only 50 cents down. Diesel was looking tight for prompt dates and premiums on Russians gained up to $2 a tonne.
Fuel oil prices treaded water with high sulphur barge prices bouncing off support levels at around $81 fob. Cargo talk was widely spread.
